Based on the search results, **Chris Jericho** holds the record for the most Intercontinental Championship wins with **9 reigns**.

In 2008, Jericho won the Intercontinental Championship on **March 10, 2008**, on an episode of **Monday Night Raw in Milwaukee, Wisconsin**. Chris Jericho stands alone when it comes down to the most Intercontinental Championship reigns in WWE history. Jericho is a record-breaking nine-time Intercontinental Champion, but despite winning the title nine times, he hasn't held the title collectively for one year.
Jericho's eighth Intercontinental Championship reign in 2008 was his longest run with the title at 111 days. Furthermore, Y2J was tailor-made for the Intercontinental Championship and clashed with Rob Van Dam, Chyna, Christian, and Rey Mysterio over the title. His feud with Mysterio over the gold in 2009 was off the charts showcasing the two veterans at their best.
